#059 · Legendary Pokémon

Arcanine

Fire

Kanto · Generation 1

Arcanine is a Fire-type Legendary Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.9 m tall and weighs 155 kg. It evolves from Growlithe. Its highest base stat is Attack (110), with a base stat total of 555.
